entries.zh: 親厚：亲厚，亲密厚交之友
entries.en: close and dear friends; intimate friends

entries.zh: 心膂：心腹至交，如心与脊膂相连之友
entries.en: bosom friends, as of the heart and backbone (close as heart and loins)
entries.notes: 汉字栏有[疑:膂/脊]标注，字有异读但'心膂/心腹之友'义与西语 coracon y entrañas 相合

entries.zh: 知巳：知己，深知交心之友
entries.en: intimate friends, friends who know one well
entries.notes: 汉字栏有[疑:巳/己]标注，'知己'义由西语 mijomo（同乡密友）与音写 quy 合证

entries.zh: 說合：说合，居中说合使结为友
entries.en: to mediate so as to make friends of people; to bring parties together

entries.zh: 佐會：相会而结交，聚而友之
entries.en: to come together in friendship; to associate and join in amity

entries.zh: 契合：契合，两心相投、志愿相合之友
entries.en: friends whose desires accord; congenial, well-matched friends

entries.zh: 得心：得心，洞悉其心之友；心意相知
entries.en: friends who know the heart; friends who understand one's mind

entries.zh: 反面：反面，翻脸绝交、破裂友谊之友
entries.en: friends who break off the friendship; to turn against (a former friend)

entries.zh: 反骨：反骨，背叛君王尊长之不忠之友
entries.en: treacherous friends who betray their king or superiors; faithless friends

entries.zh: 恩情：恩情，有大恩义、互相受益之交
entries.en: friends bound by kindness and favor; great friends who benefit each other

entries.zh: 恩愛：恩爱，深相爱敬之挚友
entries.en: friends who love each other greatly; friends bound by mutual affection

entries.zh: 人情意好：人情意好，交情意气俱佳之完美良友
entries.en: a perfect friend; one of kindly feelings and good will

entries.zh: 私和：私和，和善恳切之友
entries.en: courteous, amicable friends; gentle and obliging friends
entries.notes: '私和'字面与西语 corteses（谦和有礼）对应稍疏，按音写与语境取'和善'义

entries.zh: 相同心腹：相同心腹，同心同习、情同一体之友
entries.en: friends of one heart, or much alike in habits; bosom friends of the same mind and customs

entries.zh: 得寵：得宠，得君王宠爱之亲信；最受宠爱之女伴
entries.en: favorites of the king; the most cherished friend (mistress)

entries.zh: 家和：家和，一家之内和睦为友
entries.en: amity and friendship among members of one family; family harmony

entries.zh: 准和：准和，允准结好、许其修好
entries.en: to permit or allow the friendship; to consent to a reconciliation

entries.zh: 二人相倚：二人相倚，两人交好、彼此相依
entries.en: friendship between two persons; two people leaning on each other in amity
entries.notes: 闽南栏第四字音注 T99 污損難辨，'倚'字据汉字栏推定

entries.zh: 相放伴：相放伴，互相帮扶、分担对方劳苦之伴
entries.en: friends who help one bear the other's labors; companions who share each other's burdens

entries.zh: 磨：磨，磨物（磨米、磨刀之磨）
entries.en: to grind, to mill
entries.notes: 西语 A motar 应为 Amolar（磨）之形误，音写 Boā 与汉字合证

entries.zh: 磨陽利：磨使其利，磨快、磨锋利（刀刃）
entries.en: to sharpen, to grind until keen; to whet an edge
entries.notes: 汉字栏有[疑:陽/傷]标注，按西语 Amolar que se lipe（磨至锋利）与音写 sîo lay 取'磨利'义
